what: Popular is Puerto Rico's largest bank, with branches across the island and a mainland operation in New York, Florida and New Jersey serving Hispanic communities.
customers: Households and businesses in Puerto Rico, plus customers of its mainland United States branches.
money: lending, deposits and card services on the island
moat: Roughly half the banking market on an island of three million people, where scale in branches, payments and card processing gives it an advantage nobody else can build.
risks: Puerto Rico's economy and population have shrunk for years, which limits loan growth
Much of the island's recent growth came from federal disaster and pandemic funds that are ending
opportunities: 9.6 times earnings with a 26.0% net margin and $885M of free cash flow
Analysts see about 29% upside, with 11 covering the stock
The bank has been buying back a large share of its own stock each year
watch: Loan growth on the island and the net interest margin.
